question: The first printed edition of the Ramcharitmanas by Tulsidas was published from _______ in 1810.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta/Kolkata.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The first printed edition of the Ramcharitmanas by Tulsidas was published in Calcutta/Kolkata in 1810.**
 
• The Ramcharitmanas is written in the vernacular Awadhi language, the core of the work is considered by some to be a poetic retelling of the events of the Sanskrit epic Ramayana.
 
• It was composed by the 16th-century Indian bhakti poet Tulsidas.
 
• Other literary works of Tulsidas are
 
 
• Vinaya Partika
 
• Geetawali
 
• Dohavali
 
• Sahitya Ratna
 
• Hanuman Chalisa
 
• Vairagya Sandipani
 
• Janaki Mangal
 
• Parvati Mangal
